name: speckit-product-forge
description: Full product lifecycle orchestrator for SpecKit: research → product-spec → plan → tasks → implement → verify → test → release-readiness, across express/lite/standard/v-model modes with human-in-the-loop gates, cross-artifact sync-verify, a design-system harvest that grounds mockups in in-code components, structured journeys → Playwright E2E, a living/delta spec with a REQ→…→TEST→EVT traceability matrix, contract-first OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, telemetry wiring, a risk-scored gate review, a WCAG-AA accessibility gate, and brown-field backfill.
